question: Do they use number of votes as an indicator of preference?
title: Disunited Nations? A Multiplex Network Approach to Detecting Preference Affinity Blocs using Texts and Votes
answer_rationale: The document states that votes alone are insufficient to estimate preferences and that word embeddings and community detection in multilayer networks are used to better estimate preferences beyond votes alone, implying votes are not used as a direct indicator of preference.
